paragraphs: The Nasdaq enters the pre-market with a cautiously negative setup: the Nasdaq Score is -35/100. Consolidation Risk is 31/100 (Low).
The main cross-asset drivers are Rates are mixed: the 10Y is 4.933%. Volatility is a headwind: VXN 28.50 (+13.19%) | VIX 19.42 (+12.91%). Fed pricing remains a headwind.
Nasdaq internals are mixed, so directional confirmation is incomplete (semiconductors negative, mega-caps mixed, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require Treasury yields easing and stabilizing, semiconductors regaining leadership, broader participation. Deterioration would be reinforced by rates, volatility and leadership deteriorating together.
